issues.summary: Nested "Add manually" dialog renders without a backdrop, so it visually merges into the "My accounts" picker behind it
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: At the reviewed HEAD (6e8e123), AddManually.tsx:82-85 renders ModalDialog with no forceBackdrop prop, and ModalDialog/index.tsx:135 only draws the nested backdrop when forceBackdrop is set. The PR description's fix #3 (commit 99ed87f) isn't in this tree, so the problem is real. The ModalDialog props lines weren't changed and the bug predates the PR, so the rule caps it at low.

issues.summary: No test checks that the closed trigger updates after picking a different network
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: AddManually.test.tsx:58-66 only asserts the default chain (`Chain 1`), even though Polygon (137) is in the fixtures. A render function that hard-codes the default, or a dropped value={chainId} binding (AddManually.tsx:108), would still pass. It's a real coverage gap, but the risk is modest.

issues.summary: chainName fixture values are unused because ChainIndicator is mocked
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: ChainIndicator is mocked at AddManually.test.tsx:27-30 to render `Chain {chainId}`, so 'Ethereum'/'Polygon' (lines 7-8) never show up in any assertion. The test still catches the original bug, since a bare value would render `1`, not `Chain 1`. The fixture names are only mildly misleading.

issues.summary: waitFor is unnecessary because the mocked dialog renders synchronously
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: ModalDialog is mocked at AddManually.test.tsx:32-36 to render its children synchronously when open, so the waitFor at line 63 isn't needed. Leaving it in costs nothing beyond style.
